# Omarchy Watch 0.5.2

The first public release of Omarchy Watch, an Omarchy companion for the
Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06.

- time, date, weather, and battery at a glance
- automatic Omarchy theme and settings sync
- Codex activity and completion alerts
- secure Bluetooth pairing and automatic reconnection

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#install)
to flash the watch and install the desktop companion.

This is an independent community project for development hardware, not an
official Omarchy product or a waterproof consumer watch.
